title: erythraea centaurium subsp. capitata
intro: Erythraea centaurium subsp. capitata, commonly known as Centaury, is a subspecies of the Centaury plant, a perennial herb that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and digestive aid. The therapeutic actions of Centaury include its use in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and nausea, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. Bioactive constituents of Centaury include flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
